in_arabic.name: هدایتون
in_arabic.long_meaning: هدایتون هو اسم عربي مشتق من كلمة هداية، وهي إرشاد الله للناس إلى الصراط المستقيم، وذكر في القرآن الكريم في سورة الفرقان، الآية 31، وقد استخدم هذا الاسم في التراث الإسلامي ليعبر عن الإرشاد والهدي الذي يمنحه الله للناس

in_urdu.name: ہدایتون
in_urdu.long_meaning: ہدایتون ایک عربی نام ہے جو ہدایت کے معنی رکھتا ہے، اور یہ اللہ کی ہدایت سے متعلق ہے جو قرآن مجید میں سورہ الفرقان کی آیت 31 میں ذکر ہوا ہے، اور یہ نام اسلامی روایات میں اللہ کی ہدایت اور رہنمائی کے لیے استعمال ہوتا ہے

in_hindi.name: हिदायतोन
in_hindi.long_meaning: हिदायतोन एक अरबी नाम है जो मार्गदर्शन के अर्थ में है, और यह अल्लाह की मार्गदर्शन से संबंधित है जो कुरान में सूरा अल-Фुरकन की आयत 31 में उल्लेखित है, और यह नाम भारतीय मुसलमानों में अल्लाह की मार्गदर्शन और मार्गदर्शन के लिए प्रयोग किया जाता है

in_pashto.name: هدایتون

in_english.name: Hidayatoon
in_english.long_meaning: Hidayatoon is an Arabic name meaning guidance, related to Allah's guidance mentioned in the Quran in Surah Al-Furqan, verse 31, and this name is used in Islamic tradition to represent Allah's guidance and direction, symbolizing the spiritual path and righteousness

data.cultural_impact: The name "Hidayatoon" holds a significant cultural impact in Islamic society as it highlights the importance of guiding others towards the right path. This can refer to various aspects of life, including spiritual guidance, moral guidance, and educational guidance. Individuals bearing this name are often seen as leaders, mentors, and role models, who use their knowledge and expertise to help others navigate the challenges of life and make informed decisions. Moreover, the name "Hidayatoon" highlights the communal aspect of Islamic societies, as helping and guiding others is considered a collective responsibility, and a means of earning God's pleasure.
data.spiritual_significance: From a spiritual perspective, the name "Hidayatoon" serves as a reminder of the essential role of a spiritual guide in one's journey towards God. This can refer to a teacher, a mentor, or even abook or text that provides guidance and direction. The Islamic tradition emphasizes the importance of following a righteous path, and the name "Hidayatoon" underscores this principle by highlighting the role of the guide in helping one stay on the path of God. Ultimately, this name represents a deep spiritual commitment to helping others, which is considered a means of drawing closer to God and fulfilling one's purpose in life.
